name: Samuel Griffin
bio: a Representative from Virginia; born in 1746 in Richmond County, Va.; pursued classical studies; studied law, admitted to the bar and practiced; served in the Revolutionary War as a colonel; wounded at Harlem Heights October 12, 1776; served on the Virginia state board of war; member, Virginia state house of delegates, 1786-1788; elected as a Pro-Administration candidate to the First Congress, reelected as an Anti-Administration candidate to the Second Congress, and returned as a Pro-Administration candidate to the Third Congresses (March 4, 1789-March 3, 1795); died November 3, 1810.
